{{Youmay|suspended animation, also known as stasis|Force Stasis, a powerful version of [[Force Stasis/Legends|Force Stun]]}}
{{Quote|To what purpose? We will not notice the length of time. We will not care. We will be asleep.|[[Firrerreo/Legends|Firrerreo]] prisoner in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]|<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>}}
'''Suspended animation''', also known as '''cryofreeze''',<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> was the slowing of life processes by external means without [[Death/Legends|termination]]. Involuntary bodily functions like breathing and [[Heart/Legends|heart]] beats may still occur, but they could only be detected by artificial means. Extreme cold was used to precipitate the slowing of an individual's functions; use of this process has led to the developing science of cryonics.

Suspended animation took place throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in various forms including the [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] that carried [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers from Coruscant in the days before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-freezing]] (as in the case of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal [[Czethros]]), various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Alchemical]] techniques and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Procurator of Justice]] [[Hethrir|Lord Hethrir's]] "sleeping coffins," which kept the subject asleep and alive via life-support systems. However, there were some cases of subjects dying while being held in suspended animation. It also had the effect, after only a few months of suspension, of temporary blindness, nausea, and firing nerves upon awakening.<ref name="Quotes">{{Blog|danwallace|99|The Star Wars Atlas: Random Quotes}}</ref>
